question_text: How reliable is profile-guided optimization across workloads?

ranking.answer_fit_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that FDO can be sensitive to both training-input selection and actual runtime input, then proposes cross-validation and representative workload reduction.
ranking.interestingness_rationale: It goes beyond diagnosing unreliability by offering a compiler-centric way to select smaller representative workloads, useful for practical PGO processes.
ranking.overall_rationale: A highly relevant CGO paper that complements Aestimo by turning workload sensitivity into a workload-selection methodology, though public PDF access was not verified.

title: Workload Reduction for Multi-input Feedback-Directed Optimization
